description: Adds and/or removes contacts in a contact group (label) in one call — at least one of add/remove is required, together up to ~1000 names. Contacts are addressed by their people/<id> resource names. The HTTP 200 response is NOT a full success receipt — read it: notFoundResourceNames lists contacts that do not exist (their changes were skipped) and canNotRemoveLastContactGroupResourceNames lists contacts that could not leave their last group. Removing a contact from a group never deletes the contact, and re-running the same call converges. Contacts cannot be removed from contactGroups/myContacts this way.

add.description: Contacts to add to the group.

items.description: The contact's full resource name, e.g. "people/c1234567890" — exactly as returned by list_contacts, search_contacts or create_contact.

remove.description: Contacts to remove from the group.

items.description: The contact's full resource name, e.g. "people/c1234567890" — exactly as returned by list_contacts, search_contacts or create_contact.

resource_name.description: The group's full resource name, e.g. "contactGroups/12abc34d567" — from list_contact_groups.

name: modify_group_members
title: Add or remove group members
